content.rendered:
Come cheer on your students and their classmates as they participate in the Fun Run and raise money for our school! The schedule is as follows:
3rd Grade – 8:15 am – 8:40 am
1st Grade – 8:50 am – 9:15 am 
2nd Grade – 9:25 – 9:50 am
Kindergarten 10:00 am – 10:25 am
4th Grade – 12:15 – 12:40 pm
5th Grade – 12:50 – 1:15 pm
